summary.story: Havoc in Heaven (大鬧天宮), also translated as Uproar in Heaven, is a 1961 Chinese donghua feature film directed by Wan Laiming and produced by all four of the Wan brothers. The story is an adaptation of the earlier episodes of the 16th-century Chinese novel Journey to the West. The stylized animation and drums and percussion accompaniment used in this film are heavily influenced by Peking opera traditions.
